name: Fumou na Kankei
source:
Miku-chan is a girl whom you've been in love with for a long time.
This is a short story about the two of them forming a new relationship from an unexpected common interest.
There are no forks in the story.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE198940.html]DLsite English[/url]]
